description: A 'nyn' (Nyankole) catalog beside English. The range 'no-nyn' has the exact extlang SHAPE the lossless-extlang fallback accepts -- two alphabetic subtags of length 2 and 3 -- and its collapsed candidate 'nyn' IS a known CLDR language tag, so only the second half of DefaultStrings:2124 refuses it: the JDK materializes 'no-nyn' as the grandfathered 'nn', not as 'nyn'. A port that checked only 'is the collapsed tag known' derives a bogus nyn identity and serves the Nyankole catalog for a Norwegian request.
